description.value: While in bright light, the mutate has disadvantage on attack rolls.
The mutate makes one [[/item Corpse Swipe]] attack and two [[/item Tail]] attacks, or it makes four Tail attacks.

If the mutate is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

The mutate magically projects up to four illusory copies of itself. These duplicates make it difficult to ascertain the mutate’s true location and last until the end of the mutate’s next turn. While the copies exist, attack rolls against the mutate are made with disadvantage.

Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[poisoned] condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature can’t regain hit points.

The mutate swipes at its target.

effects.name: Poisoned
effects.description: The target has the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature can’t regain hit points.

Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

The mutate attacks with its tail.

The mutate lets out a moan charged with psychic energy. Each creature within 60 feet of the mutate that isn’t an Aberration must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 17 (5d6) psychic damage and have the &Reference[frightened]{frightened} condition until the end of the mutate’s next turn.

The mutate lets out a moan charged with psychic energy.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.description: The target has the &Reference[frightened]{frightened} condition until the end of the mutate’s next turn.
